item.description: Added/changed: No. The API rate limit (requests per second) is set per team and is the same on every plan, so upgrading doesn't change it. If your sending pattern still needs a higher limit, contact support with your expected volume and we'll review it. | No. The plans are Free, Pro, Scale, and Enterprise. It's an option on paid plans, not a plan of its own.

item.title: Neon: pricing/limits page changed
item.description: Added/changed: 1 GB/project, 20 GB account total | : Prototypes, side projects, and small teams. Includes 100 projects, 100 CU-hours/project, 1 GB Postgres storage per project (up to 20 GB total across all projects), and 5 GB of egress per project. Upgrade if you need more resources or features. | plan users get 1 GB of Postgres storage per project, up to 20 GB total across all projects | The Free plan is limited to 1 GB of Postgres storage per project, and to 20 GB in total across all your projects. These two limits are enforced independently: the total Postgres storage across all your Free projects can't exceed 20 GB, even though each project is also individually capped at 1 GB. This limit applies to Postgres storage and is separate from | Neon AI Gateway provides access to open-weight and foundation models from multiple providers through a single Neon credential. It's available on paid plans (Launch and Scale). Any paid customer with prepaid credits can use every model in the catalog; see | Storage usage is metered hourly and summed over the month. For child branches, you're billed for the minimum of accumulated changes or logical data size; capped at your actual data size. On the Free plan, you get 1 GB of Postgres storage per project, up to 20 GB total across all projects. | The Free plan costs $0/month and includes 100 projects, 10 branches per project, 100 CU-hours of compute per project per month, autoscaling up to 2 CU (≈8 GB RAM), 1 GB of Postgres storage per project (up to 20 GB total across all projects), and 5 GB of public network transfer per project per month. It also includes a 6-hour instant restore history (capped at 1 GB-month of changes), 1 manual snapshot, up to 60,000 Managed Better Auth MAU, 1 day of monitoring history, and community support. Scale to zero is always enabled (computes suspend after 5 minutes of inactivity) and can't be disabled. Compute (CU-hours) and network transfer reset each monthly billing period; projects, branches, and storage are continuous limits. For the full row-by-row breakdown, see the | On the Free plan, when you run out of CU-hours or public network transfer, your compute is suspended until the next billing period or until you upgrade. Exceeding the 1 GB per-project storage cap, or the 20 GB total cap across all your projects, causes operations that increase storage (inserts, updates, and deletes) to fail until you free space or upgrade. Branch creation fails once you reach 10 branches per project. None of these limits delete your data. — Removed: Skydive's agents deploy their own Neon backends in 0.7 seconds. Read the story | 0.5 GB/project | : Prototypes, side projects, and small teams. Includes 100 projects, 100 CU-hours/project, 0.5 GB storage per project, and 5 GB of egress per project. Upgrade if you need more resources or features. | plan users get 0.5 GB of storage per project | The Free plan is limited to 0.5 GB per project. | Neon AI Gateway provides access to open-weight and foundation models from multiple providers through a single Neon credential. It's available on paid plans (Launch and Scale). Any paid customer with prepaid credits can use the open-weight models. Foundation models are rolled out gradually; see | Storage usage is metered hourly and summed over the month. For child branches, you're billed for the minimum of accumulated changes or logical data size; capped at your actual data size. On the Free plan, you get 0.5 GB per project. | The Free plan costs $0/month and includes 100 projects, 10 branches per project, 100 CU-hours of compute per project per month, autoscaling up to 2 CU (≈8 GB RAM), 0.5 GB of storage per project, and 5 GB of public network transfer per project per month. It also includes a 6-hour instant restore history (capped at 1 GB-month of changes), 1 manual snapshot, up to 60,000 Managed Better Auth MAU, 1 day of monitoring history, and community support. Scale to zero is always enabled (computes suspend after 5 minutes of inactivity) and can't be disabled. Compute (CU-hours) and network transfer reset each monthly billing period; projects, branches, and storage are continuous limits. For the full row-by-row breakdown, see the | On the Free plan, when you run out of CU-hours or public network transfer, your compute is suspended until the next billing period or until you upgrade. Exceeding the 0.5 GB storage cap causes operations that increase storage (inserts, updates, and deletes) to fail until you free space or upgrade. Branch creation fails once you reach 10 branches per project. None of these limits delete your data.
